maintenance_led.reason: Restaurant meals (steaks, ribs, sides) sold to diners are consumables, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers paying for restaurant meals and beverages at Texas Roadhouse and Bubba's 33 restaurants.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by opening its own Texas Roadhouse restaurants and increasing sales, not through a stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Diners can easily choose another restaurant; casual-dining steak meals have no switching cost or regulatory barrier.
